observation: The table, controls, and result overlay were legible, but the 256x448 backing store became softer than intended when enlarged on 390px and 430px DPR-3 screens.
The initial blind build check could operate flippers but did not express the required drag-release plunger gesture, leaving the first ball waiting and failing to validate a complete run.
changes: Kept the 256x448 logical scene and raised the device-density backing resolution while preserving nearest-neighbor raster sampling.
Exposed the visible waiting-for-launch state and taught the production smoke driver to perform a real drag-release on the right plunger before using independent flipper inputs.
Added a full shell flow check that verifies INTRO -> TITLE -> GAME -> RESULT, simultaneous two-pointer flippers, and result restart.
